prerequisites.recommended: Understanding of basic design principles (helpful but not required)

overview.positioning: Move beyond 'Death by PowerPoint' and learn to design engaging, high-impact presentations.
overview.short_description: Master slide design, animations, slide masters, and visual storytelling in PowerPoint and Canva.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Design clean, visually appealing slides without clutter
Build and manage corporate templates using the Slide Master
Use animations and transitions purposefully to enhance the message
Integrate Canva graphics seamlessly into PowerPoint decks

why_now.industry_shift: Attention spans are shorter; presentations must be highly visual and engaging.
why_now.ai_impact: AI can generate slide outlines, but compelling visual design still requires human oversight.
why_now.business_demand: Sales pitches, internal meetings, and training all rely heavily on quality slide decks.
why_now.career_opportunity: Strong presentation skills elevate your visibility within any organization.

learning_outcomes: DESIGN: Visually striking slides that communicate ideas clearly
TEMPLATE: Corporate branding guidelines using the Slide Master
ANIMATE: Elements to control the flow of information
PRESENT: Confidently using Presenter View and delivery tools

business_use_cases.business_problem: Boring, text-heavy pitches losing client interest
business_use_cases.approach: Redesign pitch deck focusing on visuals, icons, and controlled animations

ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: The narrative flow and custom branding

best_practices: Use high-quality imagery instead of bullet points where possible
Animations should explain, not just entertain

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Putting too much text on the slide instead of the speaker notes
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Put text in speaker notes; keep slides visual

career_paths.employer_expectations: Ability to distill complex information into clear visuals
career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A portfolio of redesigned, high-impact presentation decks

freelance_applications.client_workflow: Receive Outline -> Design Draft -> Client Review -> Final Polish

final_deliverables: A complete, animated, and visually engaging presentation file

assessment.criteria: Clarity of message, use of white space, appropriate animation, and template integrity

certification.title: Presentation Design Specialist
certification.criteria: Pass the final pitch deck design project

faq.question: I'm not creative, can I still learn this?
faq.answer: Yes, we teach formulaic design principles (alignment, contrast) that don't require innate artistic talent.

modules.module_purpose: Learn the principles of effective visual communication

lessons.what_is_taught: Navigating PowerPoint and using standard layouts
Choosing readable fonts and applying theme colors

lessons.why_it_matters: Visuals convey messages faster than text
lessons.what_learner_does: Replaces a bulleted list with an icon-driven layout

modules.module_purpose: Create professional corporate assets and deliver confidently

lessons.what_is_taught: Creating custom layouts and locking branding
Designing complex graphics in Canva and exporting to PPT
lessons.why_it_matters: Expands design capabilities beyond native PPT tools
lessons.what_learner_does: Designs a custom cover graphic in Canva
Animates a complex chart to reveal data step-by-step

lessons.what_is_taught: Presenter View, speaker notes, and exporting to PDF/Video
lessons.why_it_matters: Prepares the speaker for the actual presentation
lessons.what_learner_does: Configures a presentation for a dual-monitor setup

modules.business_application: High-stakes sales pitches and executive reporting
